summary.text: Kimberly McGlinchey is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Strafford 4, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists her as an education administrator with graduate degrees and a Ph.D. from the University of New Hampshire.

paragraphs.text: McGlinchey graduated from Spaulding High School and earned graduate degrees from the University of New Hampshire in 2006 and 2014 and a Ph.D. from the university in 2022, according to Ballotpedia.
Her career experience includes work as an education administrator.

In a Ballotpedia survey, McGlinchey described herself as a 25-year public educator who has worked in the environmental field and public education, and a lifelong New Hampshire and Strafford County resident.
She listed public education funding, lower energy costs and protection of the environment as her campaign messages.
She named the American Federation of Teachers and Progressive Turnout as endorsers.
